text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the approval of parking for a maximum period of one hour, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Knox Avenue, between Queen Street East and Eastern Avenue. The proposed amendment will discourage long-term daytime parking and increase parking turnover on Knox Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Knox Avenue, between Queen Street East and Eastern Avenue.
